units.source_text: 夕阳西沉，天色冥漠，自成佳趣。

en.t: The evening sun sank in the west, and the darkening sky had a quiet charm of its own.

units.source_text: 四周烟雾弥漫，山阴顿觉幽暗。

en.t: Mist spread all around, and the shadowed side of the mountain suddenly felt deep and dim.

units.source_text: 鸣蜩四起，聒噪不已。

en.t: Cicadas began calling on every side, shrilling without pause.

units.source_text: 墙根抚子盛开，迎风拜舞，袅娜可爱。

en.t: By the foot of the wall, pinks bloomed in profusion, bowing and swaying into the wind with graceful loveliness.

units.source_text: 庭前各种秋花，任意乱开。

en.t: Before the garden, all kinds of autumn flowers bloomed freely in a lovely disorder.

units.source_text: 水声淙淙，凉气逼人；山风呼呼，其音凄厉；松涛万顷，奔腾澎湃。

en.t: The water murmured clearly, bringing a chill that pressed close; the mountain wind roared with a desolate sound; and the vast waves of pines surged and thundered.

units.source_text: 忽闻钟声响彻云霄，

en.t: Suddenly the sound of a bell rang out, seeming to pierce the clouds.

units.source_text: 此乃宣告昼夜不断诵经的僧人轮班的时间到了，

en.t: It announced that the time had come for the monks who chanted sutras day and night without cease to change shifts.

units.source_text: 离座僧人和接替僧人的念诵声和合一致，音调非常庄严。

en.t: The voices of the monks leaving their seats and those taking their places joined as one, their chanting deeply solemn.

units.source_text: 夕雾身在其间，但觉所见所闻，无不凄凉动人，

en.t: Standing amid it all, Yugiri felt that everything he saw and heard was lonely and moving.

units.source_text: 便满怀感慨，耽入沉思，竟不想回家去了。

en.t: Filled with emotion, he sank into deep thought and no longer wished to go home.

units.source_text: 律师正在祈祷，诵念陀罗尼之声十分庄严。

en.t: The preceptor was praying, and his voice as he recited the dharani was profoundly solemn.

units.source_text: 忽闻众侍女相告：老夫人病状不佳。

en.t: Then he heard the maidservants telling one another that the old lady's condition was poor.

units.source_text: 大家就聚集到病房中去了。

en.t: Everyone then gathered in the sickroom.

units.source_text: 旅居之所，侍女本来不多，

en.t: Since this was only a temporary residence, there had not been many maidservants to begin with.

units.source_text: 此时公主身边侍女极少，

en.t: At that moment, very few attendants remained by the princess's side.

units.source_text: 公主只是独坐沉思，四周肃静无声。

en.t: The princess sat alone in thought, while everything around her was still and silent.

units.source_text: 夕雾觉得披露心事的时机到了。

en.t: Yugiri felt that the moment had come to reveal what was in his heart.

units.source_text: 忽然夜雾四起，封锁窗户。

en.t: Suddenly night mist rose on every side and sealed off the windows.

units.source_text: 他便叫道：“归途方向也迷失了，如何是好呢？”

en.t: He called out, "I have even lost the direction of the way home. What am I to do?"

units.source_text: 接着吟诗云：

en.t: Then he recited a poem, saying:
